title: Fuel and stint strategy
description: Fuel and stint strategy — provisioned openlaps endurance operations dashboard.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: stint
list.label: Stint
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every rule in the openlaps folder that is firing right now, wherever you are looking. Acknowledge on the annunciator (notifier, port 8086); this strip shows, it does not silence.

panels.title: Fuel remaining

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, fuel_remaining_l AS "Fuel remaining", fuel_remaining_lo_l AS "Lower bound", rebase_confidence AS "Re-base" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Tank contents by the P6.3 model, computed by the strategy service: the last level re-base less the counter deltas since. `Re-base` says where that reading came from (key_on: stationary after a refuel; moving: the live level sensor, which sloshes; plan: no reading at all).

panels.title: Laps to dry (lower bound)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, laps_to_dry_lo AS "Laps to dry", laps_to_dry_hi AS "Upper bound", burn_laps AS "Laps in burn" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: The number that gets radioed is the lower bound: usable fuel at the low end over burn at the high end (mean + 2 sd of the last clean laps). `Laps in burn` is how many laps that mean rests on -- three laps and a full stint must not look alike.

panels.title: Pit window

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, window_open_lap AS "Opens at lap", window_close_lap AS "Closes at lap", stops_needed AS "Stops needed" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Earliest lap the car can stop and still make the end with the planned number of stops; latest lap it can stay out on the lower-bound fuel. Empty when the car makes the end without stopping.

panels.title: Target lap time

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, target_lap_s AS "Target lap" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: The lap time that reaches the next planned stop (or a time-authority race end) exactly dry: time to that moment over laps to dry. Only defined when the next stop is planned at a wall-clock time -- against a stop at a lap, pace does not change whether the fuel lasts.

panels.title: Driver time remaining

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, driver AS "Driver", driver_time_remaining_s AS "Continuous", driver_total_remaining_s AS "Total" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Against the race plan's regulation limits: remaining continuous time in this stint and remaining total for this driver. A strategy finding fires within the configured margin and goes critical past the limit.

panels.title: Refuelling legal release

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, refuel_elapsed_s AS "Elapsed", refuel_remaining_s AS "To legal minimum", refuel_release_at AS "Release at" FROM v_strategy_latest WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

panels.description: Live only while a refuel stop is open: elapsed since the PitEntryRefuel crossing, remaining to the plan's regulated minimum, and the wall time the car may be released. Releasing early is a penalty, not a gain.

panels.title: Fuel used per lap and rolling five-lap mean

targets.rawSql: SELECT crossed_at AS time, fuel_used_l AS "Fuel used per lap", avg(fuel_used_l) OVER (ORDER BY crossed_at ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Rolling five-lap mean" FROM v_lap_fuel WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND measurement_status = 'clean' ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.description: Counter-reset laps are gaps, never negative spikes; uncertainty is visible through the rolling sample count.

panels.title: Fuel level cross-check and counter divergence

targets.rawSql: SELECT started AS time, level_start_l AS "Fuel level start cross-check", level_end_l AS "Fuel level end cross-check", level_used_l - COALESCE((SELECT sum(fuel_used_l) FROM v_lap_fuel lf WHERE lf.vehicle_id = sf.vehicle_id AND lf.session_id = sf.session_id AND lf.stint_number = sf.stint_number AND lf.measurement_status = 'clean'), 0.0) AS "Level vs counter divergence" FROM v_stint_fuel_level sf WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(started) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY started

panels.description: The slow-smoothed level sender is a cross-check. It re-bases only after a refuel; fuel temperature correction is not included.

panels.title: Laps to dry, with bounds

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, laps_to_dry_lo AS "Laps to dry (lower)", laps_to_dry_hi AS "Laps to dry (upper)", window_close_lap AS "Window closes at lap" FROM v_strategy_history WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY time

panels.description: The strategy service's projection per evaluation, drawn as a band between its lower and upper bound rather than one line: a projection from three laps is wide and one from a full stint is narrow, and the crew can see which they are looking at. Counter-reset laps are excluded from the burn, never averaged in. Strategy alerts annotate this panel.

panels.title: Burn per lap used by strategy, and fuel added at stops

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, burn_l_per_lap AS "Burn per lap (rolling mean)", burn_l_per_lap + 2 * burn_sd AS "Burn upper bound", fuel_added_l AS "Fuel added at refuel" FROM v_strategy_history WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY time

panels.description: The rolling mean over the last clean laps (in-laps, out-laps, counter resets and lap-time outliers excluded) and its upper bound, which is what laps to dry is computed against. Fuel added is the level after a refuel less the level before it: a short fill shows here and raises a strategy finding.

panels.title: Stop plan: what the numbers say vs what the operator entered

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.time, (stop ->> 'lap')::int AS "Stop at lap", stop ->> 'type' AS "Type", stop ->> 'reason' AS "Why", stop ->> 'driver_in' AS "Driver in", (stop ->> 'planned_lap')::int AS "Operator planned lap", (stop ->> 'delta_laps')::int AS "Drift (laps)" FROM v_strategy_latest s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.stop_plan) AS stop WHERE s.vehicle_id = '$vehicle' ORDER BY 2

panels.description: Recomputed every lap from the burn, the stop minimum and the driver limits, and diffed against the race plan entered on the session UI, so the gap between the plan and what the numbers now say is visible before it is a problem. A drift beyond the configured laps raises a strategy finding.

panels.title: Open strategy findings

targets.rawSql: SELECT opened_at AS time, monitor AS "Monitor", severity AS "Severity", summary ->> 'message' AS "Detail" FROM v_watch_findings WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND monitor LIKE 'strategy.%' AND closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at DESC

panels.description: Driver time within its margin, the pit window closing, the computed plan drifting from the operator's, a short fill. Each is also a Grafana alert (strategy-warning, strategy-critical) that reaches the annunciator and the phones.

options.content: Every projection here is computed by the strategy service and read from `v_strategy_latest` / `v_strategy_history`; no panel does the arithmetic. Counter-reset laps are omitted from the burn, not treated as zero; in-laps, out-laps and lap-time outliers are excluded too. `car.fuel_level` is the **cross-check** except at a post-refuel re-base, where it is the model's anchor -- the `Re-base` label says which. Radio the lower bound. The refuelling legal minimum comes from the race plan, not from this dashboard.
